author: Nate Miller
title: Kyle Schwarber (back) a late scratch Tuesday night
desc: Kyle Schwarber (back) was a late scratch from Tuesday's starting lineup.
impact: Schwarber is reportedly dealing with some lower back tightness. Edmundo Sosa moved into the lineup at DH. Schwarber should be considered day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Alec Burleson enters lineup Tuesday
desc: Alec Burleson is in the Cardinals lineup on Tuesday against the Diamondbacks.
impact: Burleson was originally expected to get the day off. With Masyn Winn scratched, Burleson will bat seventh and start at first base.

author: Nate Miller
title: CJ Abrams (side) out of Tuesday's lineup
desc: CJ Abrams (side) was scratched from Tuesday's starting lineup.
impact: Abrams is reportedly dealing with tightness on his left side. Nasim Nunez will slide over to shortstop while Jorbit Vivas starts at second base. Abrams should be considered day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Griffin Canning to pitch in bulk relief role Tuesday
desc: Griffin Canning will pitch in a bulk relief role on Tuesday.
impact: Wandy Peralta will open for the Padres with Canning following him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: JP Sears recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Padres recalled JP Sears from Triple-A El Paso.
impact: Sears gets an opportunity in the majors with Lucas Giolito placed on the injured list. It is unclear if he'll pitch on Tuesday behind Wandy Peralta, who is opening for San Diego.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Wandy Peralta to start Tuesday
desc: Wandy Peralta will start for the Padres on Tuesday against the Braves.
impact: Peralta will likely pitch the first inning or two. It is unclear who will follow him.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Lucas Giolito (elbow) placed on IL
desc: The Padres placed Lucas Giolito on the 15-day injured list with right elbow inflammation.
impact: Giolito will get some time off following his recent struggles. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.

author: Nate Miller
title: Chase Dollander (elbow) will not pitch again in 2026
desc: Chase Dollander (elbow) will not return to the mound for the Rockies in 2026.
impact: Dollander has been out since the middle of May after suffering what was then labelled an elbow sprain. The 24-year-old righty underwent internal brace surgery on that elbow Monday, and he will be out for at least the remainder of this season.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Tucker (back) hopeful to return to lineup Friday
desc: Dodgers manager Dave Roberts said he is hopeful Kyle Tucker can return to the lineup for Friday's series opener against the Padres.
impact: Roberts already ruled out Tucker for the remainder of the current Twins series. He remains day-to-day.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Mark Leiter Jr. (hip) going through throwing progression
desc: Mark Leiter Jr. is going through a throwing progression.
impact: Leiter landed on the injured list over the weekend. He'll look to resume throwing off the mound soon.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Denzel Clarke (hamstring) plays catch, resumes swinging
desc: Denzel Clarke has started to play catch and a swinging progression.
impact: Clarke was transferred to the 60-day injured list back in late-May. He is continuing to slowly work his way back from a hamstring injury.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Brent Rooker (knee) still not doing baseball activities
desc: Brent Rooker remains held out of baseball activities.
impact: Rooker was placed on the injured list over a week and a half ago. He remains without a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Romy Gonzalez (shoulder/hip) targeting return Saturday
desc: Romy Gonzalez told reporters he is targeting Saturday against the Yankees for his season debut.
impact: Gonzalez said his hip is fine. He'll continue to play in rehab games through Saturday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Rafael Devers expected to be in lineup Tuesday
desc: Rafael Devers is expected to be in the Giants lineup on Tuesday.
impact: Buster Posey said manager Tony Vitello spoke to Devers.  "Everybody has missteps," he said.
